column5: Zero-step and low-use days indicate an adoption gap. Trigger setup help, fit/comfort tips, charging reminders, and a 7-day comeback challenge before offering upgrades.
Use performance messaging for active users and simple habit-building messaging for lighter users. The same product pitch should not be used for every segment.
Saturday has the strongest average step level. Launch Friday evening challenges, weekend streaks, and social referral campaigns when users are naturally more active.
Entry device for habit formation, core watch for daily consistency, and premium watch/accessory bundles for highly active users.
Capture device model, wear location, acquisition source, tenure, campaign exposure, renewals, and purchases to measure conversion—not just activity.
